title: Stripe payment received
summary: Records every paid Stripe Checkout session the moment Stripe reports it, once, and tells your team.
description: A Stripe-signed webhook records each paid Checkout session in a stripe_payment table, once (Stripe's event id and the session id both guard against repeats). Every new payment notifies your staff and emails the payer a short receipt. A Payments page for staff lists them, with a Check Stripe now button as a fallback that pulls recent sessions with your secret key (it never reaches the browser).

params.name: staff_role
params.label: Who manages payments
params.description: The staff role that sees the Payments page, can check Stripe and is told about new payments.

notes: A Stripe webhook endpoint at the URL get_contract lists for stripe-checkout-events (Backend, API in the builder), sending checkout.session.completed, with its signing secret in STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY only for the Check Stripe now fallback (a restricted key with read access to Checkout Sessions is enough).

includes: Table stripe_payment (one row per paid Checkout session)
A Stripe-signed webhook that records each paid session
Workflow: notify staff and email a receipt on each new payment
highlights: Verified with Stripe's own signature, on the raw request
